# Keeton Martin

> Software engineer in New York building an AI wealth assistant at Range across iMessage and the web. He designed and shipped its proactive execution system for follow-ups, household financial reviews, and outreach when something needs attention. His work includes background workflows with safe retries, consent and quiet-hours controls, end-to-end evaluations, agent memory, iMessage reliability, and full-stack brokerage and advisor tools.

Previously a Member of Technical Staff at Salesforce (2022–2025), where he led a greenfield ETL product from zero to 1.2M transactions in six months. B.S. Computer Science, Haverford College (2022), minors in neuroscience and statistics.

## Projects

- [Incolia](https://incolia.com): A platform for persistent AI identities, scoped permissions, and communication between autonomous agents.
- [Railwatch](https://railwatch.app): Live Amtrak tracking, station boards, and train status for AI assistants through MCP.
- [Plenary](https://github.com/KeetonMartin/plenary): A consensus protocol for humans and agents, with a CLI, MCP server, and transcript viewer
- [Scanify](https://keetonmartin.com/scanify): On-device OCR for pulling searchable text out of images
- [RecRouter](https://recrouter.net): Recruiter outreach tracker with AI email parsing
- [Routerunner](https://keetonmartin.github.io/routerunner/): Recommends credit cards based on the route you fly most
- [Election 2024](https://keetonmartin.github.io/election2024/): A polling-driven model of the US general election
- [Corne layout](https://github.com/KeetonMartin/zmk-config2): ZMK config for a small split ergonomic keyboard
